question: What is Diginex

beats.line: Diginex is repositioning as a unified sustainability, data and compliance platform.
beats.headline: ONE PLATFORM
events: A flat paper platform slab drops onto empty violet ground, opening cold.
The slab settles as a cream chip slides in beside it.
A paper hand presses the chip flat against the slab's edge.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] Diginex is repositioning as a unified sustainability, data and compliance platform.

beats.line: Its software helps organisations collect, manage and report ESG data.
beats.headline: ESG REPORTING
events: The platform slab, already in place, is joined by stacked paper sheets entering from the edge.
The sheets fan out across the slab and square themselves into a neat pile.
A black chip slaps in beneath the pile, which stays where it landed.
beats.delivery: Its software helps organisations collect, manage and report ESG data.

beats.line: Four businesses absorbed: Plan A, Matter, The Remedy Project, Resulticks.
beats.headline: 4 ACQUISITIONS
events: The violet chips slide off the bottom edge as the stacked sheets flip away onto fresh cyan ground.
Four hole-punched tags drop in and are threaded onto a single string.
A paper hand pulls the string taut and the tags line up.
beats.delivery: Four businesses absorbed: Plan A, Matter, The Remedy Project, Resulticks.

beats.line: The one point five billion dollar Resulticks deal is the pivotal move.
beats.headline: $1.5B RESULTICKS
events: The threaded tags stay strung as an oversized rubber stamp swings in from above.
The stamp presses down hard over the last tag on the string.
A large black chip slaps in and the hero figure prints big.
beats.delivery: [excited] The one point five billion dollar Resulticks deal is the pivotal move.

beats.line: The platform spans carbon accounting, supply chain transparency and human rights.
beats.headline: END-TO-END
events: The threaded tags and stamp hold position as a folded paper map opens beneath them.
The map unfolds into four labelled panels under the string of tags.
A black chip slaps onto the map's corner and holds.
beats.delivery: The platform spans carbon accounting, supply chain transparency and human rights.

beats.line: As of early September twenty twenty-six, shares trade at one dollar sixteen.
events: The cyan chips slide off as the paper map is covered over on magenta ground.
A paper bar chart rises, then its bars tear down to a short strip.
A black chip slaps in beside the torn strip and stays.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] As of early September twenty twenty-six, shares trade at one dollar sixteen.

beats.line: Integration execution across multiple jurisdictions is the primary risk.
beats.headline: INTEGRATION RISK
events: The bar chart holds its place as loose paper clips scatter in from the edge.
A paper hand tries to clip four separate sheets into one bundle.
The bundle bulges and a black chip slaps in over it.
beats.delivery: Integration execution across multiple jurisdictions is the primary risk.

beats.line: Admin expenses rose three point four million to eight point one million.
beats.headline: G&A $8.1M
events: The clipped bundle and its chip stay put as paper coins pour in from above.
The coins pile against the bar chart until one bar grows taller.
A black chip slaps in over the tall bar and locks.
beats.delivery: Admin expenses rose three point four million to eight point one million.

beats.line: Brazil's seventy-seven billion dollar sustainability market is a signalled growth vector.
beats.headline: $77B BRAZIL
events: The magenta chips slide off the top edge as the platform slab returns on violet ground.
A stencilled arrow enters and sweeps outward from the slab.
A black chip slaps in at the arrow's tip and holds.
beats.delivery: Brazil's seventy-seven billion dollar sustainability market is a signalled growth vector.

beats.line: A speculative micro-cap, suited to investors with patience for integration.
beats.headline: SPECULATIVE
events: The stencilled arrow rolls away, leaving the platform slab exactly where it sat.
A single hole-punched tag ties onto the slab, the one new element.
A paper hand presses the tag flat and a black chip lands.
beats.delivery: A speculative micro-cap, suited to investors with patience for integration.
